text: Assumption: The DEFERRED notification during reception is executed in Com_MainFunctionRx — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: The DEFERRED notification during reception is executed in Com_MainFunctionRx — is this correct?
norm: the deferred notification during reception is executed in com_mainfunctionrx
assumption: The DEFERRED notification during reception is executed in Com_MainFunctionRx.
rationale: The figure SWS COM page 92 only shows checking the flag later; according to SWS_Com_00398, Com_MainFunctionRx performs the reception processing not handled directly in Com_RxIndication.

original.text: Annahme: Die DEFERRED-Benachrichtigung beim Empfang wird in Com_MainFunctionRx ausgeführt (auch in diag-empfang) — trifft das zu?
original.assumption: Die DEFERRED-Benachrichtigung beim Empfang wird in Com_MainFunctionRx ausgeführt (auch in diag-empfang)
original.rationale: Die Figur SWS COM S. 92 zeigt nur ein späteres Prüfen des Flags; laut SWS_Com_00398 übernimmt Com_MainFunctionRx die nicht direkt in Com_RxIndication erledigte Empfangsverarbeitung.
